author: Hola
body:
Hi I'm LFT. I come from OCN and have experience from tournaments 5-9. The last tournament I played was with 5entsFromHeaven and we finished 4th. I'm 14 and from Finland. My timezone is GMT+2/+3 depends on sunlight saving or whatever.

Pros: 

Can play any position

Decent at both sword and bow

Proefficient with cannons

Calm

Cons:

Nothing above average at pvp

EU timezone can be bad if in a US team
